chain_words.nuance: to add a brief explanation of a word or phrase
to restate a passage in different words
to render a text from one language into another
to reproduce the sense and style of a source text in the target language
to move a work into a different register or form while keeping its essence

explanation: These words all describe carrying a text's meaning from one form to another, from a brief gloss to a full transposition of the work.

usage_notes.difference: 'Translate' means converting words into another language; 'render' means reproducing the sense and style of the original, which requires artistic judgement.
